Check and control: [ ] C — Institutional account expiry or access loss has been closed safely.
Pass evidence and failure action: Where activated, export only permitted records through authorised routes and confirm an alternative contact or retrieval path. Do not copy restricted material to an unauthorised service.

Pass evidence and failure action: Remove identity documents, signatures, receipts, secrets, hidden content and metadata from release candidates. Do not publish before written rights and publication decisions.

Pass evidence and failure action: Record PASS, BLOCKED, RETURN TO CURRENT-SESSION COMPLIANCE, RETURN TO EDITORIAL GATE, RETURN TO EARLIEST SCIENTIFIC GATE or WITHHOLD PUBLIC RELEASE, with owner and next action.
